title: Graceful forests with one big tree
words: A forest with c trees and m edges is graceful-forest labelled if its vertices get the labels 0 to m + c − 1 with all edge differences distinct. Show this works whenever there are at least two trees and one of them holds more than half the edges.
math: Prove every forest with $m$ edges and $c\ge2$ components, one of which has more than $m/2$ edges, has a bijection $V\to\{0,\dots,m+c-1\}$ with all $|\ell(u)-\ell(v)|$, $uv\in E$, distinct.
